subject.title: fix(channels): run outbound hooks on routed agent replies

question: Should OpenClaw expose provider-owned message_sending delivery as a supported channel plugin SDK mode, or should the implementation keep that ownership internal to core while preserving one public core-managed delivery contract?
rationale: The PR documents and types a new delivery-ownership mode that affects the plugin SDK safety boundary; choosing its permanent public contract cannot be resolved from tests alone.

options.title: Approve the explicit provider-owned mode
options.body: Accept the new typed SDK mode after confirming its compatibility contract, ownership documentation, and real-channel proof cover all provider funnels.

options.title: Keep hook ownership in core
options.body: Refactor the exceptional provider paths behind a core-owned adapter so plugin authors retain one delivery contract and cannot accidentally bypass the safety hook.

recommendation.title: Approve the explicit provider-owned mode
recommendation.body: Accept the new typed SDK mode after confirming its compatibility contract, ownership documentation, and real-channel proof cover all provider funnels.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked report defines the affected safety boundary and its intended behavioral contract; an area owner identified from mainline history should join the decision once history access is available.
